name: NZ Avalanche Risk Forecasts
description: Ingests avalanche danger forecasts from avalanche.net.nz for New Zealand avalanche regions and submits them to CloudTAK as CoT features.

permissions.description: Submits avalanche forecast risk features for NZ avalanche regions

schedule.description: Polls avalanche.net.nz for the latest forecast per NZ avalanche region and submits them as CoT features
